title: attest init --json
description: Files `attest init` (Python and TypeScript SDK CLIs) wrote or left alone in the project root. Paths are relative to the project root, use forward slashes and are sorted. With --skills, the agent skills from `attest-engine skills install` are included: its created and updated paths as created and updated, its unchanged paths as skipped. With --mcp, the client configs from `attest-engine mcp install` are included the same way: its created and updated paths, and its unchanged and conflict paths as skipped.

created.description: Files that did not exist and were written.
